title: Maurice to Rupert, Worcester, 7 July 1645, and royalist intercepts, BL Add MS 72438 ff. 9-10 (1646)

documents.shelfmark: Printed in Warburton, Memoirs of Prince Rupert (1849) iii. 133; original presumably BL Add MS 18980-82

plaintext.source: No key or decipherment known in print.

transcription.notes: Count from NOTES; the ciphertext sits in a Python script, not a text file.

documents.shelfmark: BL Add MS 72438 ff. 9-10 (DECODE R8623, R8624)

transcription.source: Tomokiyo prints the first two lines of f. 9 only

system.summary: Royalist numeric nomenclator: two-digit figures for letters, figures from about 100 to 398 (1645) or 500 (1646) for words.
system.sibling_key: Charles I-Rupert-Digby-Ormonde 1644-45 and Nicholas-Rupert July 1645 keys tested by range: do not fit
system.notes: Distinct symbols counted for the 1645 letter only (18 below 100, 45 above).

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.

solution.what: Maurice's letter taken from the Warburton OCR; structure counted.
Known royalist key ranges compared with the 1645 figures.
Keys and originals located in BL Add MS 18980-82 and 72438; BL images offline since 2023, DECODE private.

outcome.method_basis: Maurice's 1645 ciphertext exists only in Warburton's 1849 print and no fitting key is known; the Add MS 72438 intercepts and keys are offline (BL images down since 2023, DECODE records private).
outcome.notes: Needs the BL images back online or DECODE access with BL permission; 49 Digby keys in Add MS 72438 would likely read the intercepts by trial.
